matches the description.

deterministic_rule_draft.prompt:
Scene:
  Type: Dense central-Paris-style urban district
  Atmosphere: Quiet, slightly overcast
  Terrain: Flat
Urban layout:
  Block count: Roughly twenty tightly packed mid-rise perimeter blocks
  Road network: Narrow streets and a few wider intersecting avenues
  Block geometry: Irregular trapezoidal, triangular, polygonal; following angled roads
  Street frontages: Nearly continuous; close clustering creates urban canyons
  Junctions: Defined by chamfered corners and wedge-shaped buildings
  Interior courtyards:
    Enclosure: Enclosed within blocks
    Unfinished examples: Several visibly unfinished; tall plain off-white inner walls, flat gray paving
Buildings:
  Height: Predominantly six to seven stories
  Style: Consistent Haussmannian
  Facades: Pale weathered stone; repetitive tall windows, black wrought-iron balcony rails, decorative cornices
  Roofs: Dark gray mansard; dormer windows and chimneys
  Doors: Occasional arched blue or red
Ground and traffic:
  Surfaces: Dark asphalt roads; broad gray stone sidewalks
  Markings: Painted lane arrows, dashed markings, zebra crossings
  Islands: Small traffic islands
  Selected curbs: Black bollards and metal pedestrian railings
  Prominent intersection: Traffic lights
  Side street: Red no-entry sign
  General signage: Scattered street signs and poles
Street life:
  Bistro corner: Bicycle rack with several bicycles beside a corner bistro
  Other details: Sparse young sidewalk trees, a few benches or cafe chairs, occasional small street clutter
  Occupancy: Almost no people or vehicles
Outer termination:
  Built edges: Abruptly cut building blocks, blank courtyard shells
  Surroundings: Gray ground planes and an empty pale sky
